title: Joshua Stewart Cloud Context Pack - Evaluation Suite Schema
description: Schema for evals/evals.json, the declarative definition of the baseline-versus-pack evaluation suite. Validated offline by evals/run.mjs using a small hand-written JSON Schema subset validator (type incl. type arrays, const, enum, pattern, format: date|date-time|uri, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum, minItems, maxItems, uniqueItems, required, properties, items, additionalProperties: false). It is not a general-purpose JSON Schema engine: no $ref, no oneOf/anyOf/allOf, no $defs, no conditional keywords. Keep this file inside that subset or run.mjs will not be able to enforce it. The $id names this repository's intended canonical GitHub location; the repository has not been published yet, so treat that URL as aspirational.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema file, for editor tooling.

suiteVersion.description: Semantic version of the eval suite's own shape and case set, independent of the pack's VERSION. Bump the minor version when a case is added or its assertions change in a way that makes past results non-comparable.

status.description: Whether this suite has ever been executed end to end. 'not-run' means no result in this repository may be presented as a measurement of anything.

notes.description: Free-text notes about the suite as a whole, including honesty caveats.

version.description: Pack version this suite was written against, copied from VERSION/manifest.json at authoring time. run.mjs re-reads the live value at prepare time and records any mismatch.

skillsAuthored.description: Number of authored skills in .agents/skills at the time this suite was written. If 0, the with_pack arm carries no skill content and any measured difference between arms would be noise, not lift.

caveat.description: Plain-language statement of what this suite cannot currently prove.

with_pack.description: Exactly what is present in the with_pack workspace.

without_pack.description: Exactly what is present in the without_pack workspace. Must differ from with_pack only by pack context.

tools.description: Agent tools this suite is intended to be run against, manually. Nothing in this repository launches them.

invocation.description: Fixed value. This suite never automates a proprietary agent CLI; the operator drives the tool by hand.

releaseGate.description: Whether a protocol-complete benchmark for this tool is required before the pack may make a behavioural release claim. Exactly one tool must be designated.

transcriptCapture.description: How the operator is expected to capture a full transcript for this tool, without asserting a capability that has not been confirmed.

tokenReporting.description: Whether token counts are available from the tool itself. 'unverified' means the suite author has not confirmed either way; the operator records what they actually observe in run.json.

status.description: 'provisional-unauthored' means these slugs are eval-side hypotheses about which skill each case would exercise. They are not a decision about the pack's skill set and must not be treated as evidence that any skill exists.

authored.description: Whether .agents/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md actually exists. run.mjs re-checks this at prepare time and warns on mismatch.

id.description: Stable, unique, kebab-case identifier. Used as a directory name under iteration-N/.

riskLevel.description: Severity of the real-world consequence described in 'risk', not the difficulty of the case.

risk.description: What actually goes wrong in production if an agent handles this case badly.

prompt.description: The exact text the operator pastes into the agent. Identical for both arms; the only permitted difference between arms is the presence of pack context.

promptNotes.description: Operator guidance about the prompt (e.g. what must NOT be added to it, such as hints that would leak the expected answer).

source.description: Path relative to evals/. Must stay inside evals/fixtures/.

mountAt.description: Destination inside the prepared workspace. '.' means the fixture directory's contents become the workspace root.

required.description: If true, absence of this artifact is a blocking failure for the case.

type.description: Mechanical types are executed by evals/run.mjs --grade against files only (read, hash, regex, JSON.parse). 'manual' types require a human or a blinded LLM judge and a quoted piece of evidence recorded in run.json. See ASSERTIONS.md.

severity.description: 'blocking' failures fail the case. 'advisory' failures are recorded and reported but do not fail the case; use it where a reasonable agent could legitimately differ.

target.description: 'workspace' resolves paths inside <arm>/workspace/. 'transcript' operates on <arm>/transcript.md and ignores 'path'.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path. Required by file-exists, file-absent, file-matches, file-not-matches, json-parses, file-unchanged, file-changed when target is 'workspace'.

pathGlob.description: Glob used by any-file-matches / no-file-matches. Supports ** (any depth), * (within a path segment) and ?.

pattern.description: JavaScript regular expression source, applied to file text. Required by the *-matches types.

flags.description: Regular expression flags. 'i' for case-insensitive, 'm' for multiline anchors.

max.description: Threshold for max-changed-files / max-added-files, compared against the prepared fixture manifest.

securityRelevant.description: If true, a with_pack failure where without_pack passed counts as a security regression in the launch gates.

correctnessRelevant.description: If true, a with_pack failure where without_pack passed counts as a correctness regression in the launch gates. Defaults to true for blocking assertions when omitted.

rationale.description: Why this check is fair and what it deliberately does not prove.

judge.description: Only meaningful for type 'manual'. Any LLM judge must be run blinded; see ASSERTIONS.md.

rubric.description: Scored criteria applied by a blinded judge. Every criterion requires quoted evidence; an unevidenced criterion scores 0.

relevantSkills.description: Provisional slugs from skillRegistry that this case is expected to exercise. An empty array means no single skill owns this case.

nonTrigger.description: True when the correct behaviour is for the pack NOT to influence the answer. Used by the non-trigger launch gate.

liveRetrievalRequired.description: True when the case can only be answered correctly by retrieving current vendor documentation during the run. Used by the live-retrieval launch gate.

mechanicalCoverage.description: 'full' means every blocking assertion is mechanical. 'partial' means at least one blocking assertion needs a judge. 'none' means the case is entirely judged.
